offer.title: Technicien assistance bureautique
offer.job_text: Permanent first-line helpdesk role in Brussels. Responsibilities are printer troubleshooting, Microsoft Office support, password resets and replacement of workstation hardware. The security team handles every security incident and all vulnerability management; this helpdesk position has no cybersecurity engineering or detection responsibility. Training focuses exclusively on desktop support rather than cloud, networking or automation.
